name.la: Tractatus de potestate Summi Pontificis in rebus temporalibus
name.en-US: Treatise on the Power of the Supreme Pontiff in Temporal Matters
name.pt-BR: Tratado sobre o poder do Sumo Pontífice nas coisas temporais

description.la: Adversus Guilielmum Barclaium (1610). Textus ex editione Vivès (1870-74), tomo XII, ex scanno OCR.
description.en-US: Against William Barclay (1610). Latin only: the Vivès edition (1870-74), volume 12, from an OCR scan.

sources.edition: Roberti Bellarmini Opera omnia, ed. Justin Fèvre, tom. 12 (Paris: Vivès, 1870-74).
sources.description: Archive.org OCR (djvu.txt, Boston College copy) cleaned by script: running heads, page numbers and the reference-only footnote blocks removed, line-end hyphens joined, recognisable OCR slips corrected by a lexicon pass, so some remain.
sources.tierEvidence: Bellarmine died in 1621; the Vivès edition of 1870-74 is public domain.
